name: Metal Gear Solid V: Ground Zeroes

locations.note: 1975: Snake infiltrates the American black site Camp Omega in Cuba to rescue Paz and Chico, while XOF destroys his Mother Base.
Snake flies home with Paz and Chico to find XOF destroying Mother Base; Paz's hidden bomb blows up the helicopter as they escape.

routes.name: Big Boss
routes.note: From the Cuban black site back to the burning Mother Base.
